name: Structured Output Validation
description: Scenarios that verify AI responses can be parsed and validated regardless of the model used

checks.name: Required fields present
checks.description: Every analysis response must contain all required fields as defined in the typed model

checks.name: Risk score in valid range
checks.description: Risk scores must be integers between 0 and 100

checks.name: Win probability in valid range
checks.description: Win probability must be an integer between 0 and 100

checks.name: Enum values valid
checks.description: Fields like riskLevel, verdict, priority must contain expected enum values

checks.name: Non-empty collections
checks.description: Analysis results should contain at least one item in key collections

checks.name: Summary present and non-empty
checks.description: Every analysis must include a non-empty summary string

checks.name: Identity fields overridden
checks.description: Server-side identity fields (IDs, names) must match the input, not the AI output

checks.name: Code fence stripping
checks.description: Parse methods must handle responses wrapped in markdown code fences
